text_block_list.text:
It's the day of the Oka Sho, and all eyes
are on
Hishi Amazon, as she's a favorite
to win the Triple
Tiara.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She's filled with emotion and wonder.
The way she
sees it, this path will lead
her to a stronger, better
version of
herself.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
